That actually seems to be using that check since a2e45b8fdde315b756691b4ae573ad55f55dc002

So I'm not sure I should fix this as it looks like the intent was to set the below but it hasn't been happening unless I'm missing something
```
            kwargs["connect_args"] = {"check_same_thread": False}
            kwargs["poolclass"] = StaticPool
            kwargs["pool_reset_on_return"] = None
```


---
Disregard.  I've missed the intent after re-reading this.

<!--

        query: "SELECT ROUND((trip / liter),2) as km_liter FROM public.refuelings_fuel_stats ORDER BY date desc LIMIT 1;"

review_comments:
This changes behavior. 

If you specify just `sqlite://`, you get a SQLite in-memory database. If it starts with `sqlite://`, it can also be file based, like the default.

During tests we run with an in-memory DB.
That logic should still be below.  This fixes a regression I caused in b09b5729a36e69f517703038a38e197ff5c13f42
